current_detections.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
current_detections.evidence: Market structure shifted from bearish to bullish after price established a higher low near 60500 and broke above the prior swing high near 61500, reaching approximately 61800 before pulling back to current price 61478.87.
current_detections.missing_conditions: Sustained hold above the broken 61500 structure level to fully confirm the bullish regime change.

current_detections.name: Bullish Flag
current_detections.evidence: A strong impulse move from approximately 60500 to 61800 was followed by tight, downward-sloping consolidation near current price 61478.87, forming the early stages of a bullish flag.
current_detections.missing_conditions: Breakout above the flag upper boundary to confirm continuation of the uptrend.

current_detections.name: Symmetrical Triangle
current_detections.evidence: Recent price action shows contracting volatility with lower highs and higher lows forming a small consolidation pattern after the impulse rally.
current_detections.missing_conditions: Clear breakout above the upper trendline or breakdown below the lower trendline to determine direction.
